import importlib.util, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
root=pathlib.Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('audit_fixture',root/'tests/test_spa_scenarios.py')
m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='spa-target-audit-') as td:
 p=pathlib.Path(td);(p/'examples').mkdir()
 (p/'fixture.c').write_text(m.FIXTURE)
 (p/'examples/spa_agent_demo.c').write_bytes((root/'examples/spa_agent_demo.c').read_bytes())
 h=(root/'examples/spa_agent_scenarios.h').read_text()
 needle='observation(body, branch, target, counts[target], &measured_observation, &after);'
 assert h.count(needle)==2
 head,tail=h.rsplit(needle,1)
 (p/'examples/spa_agent_scenarios.h').write_text(head+'observation(body, branch, future_target, counts[future_target], &measured_observation, &after);'+tail)
 command=['cc','-O2','-std=gnu11','-pthread','-I',str(p),'-I',str(root),str(p/'fixture.c'),str(root/'spa_agent.c'),str(root/'notorch.o'),'-lm','-o',str(p/'mutant')]
 build=subprocess.run(command,text=True,capture_output=True); print('compile',build.returncode,build.stderr[-1000:])
 if build.returncode==0:
  run=subprocess.run([str(p/'mutant'),str(p/'scenario.jsonl'),str(p/'ordinary.jsonl'),'42'],text=True,capture_output=True);print('run',run.returncode,run.stdout,run.stderr[-1000:])
  if run.returncode==0:
   try:
    r=m.validate_files(p/'scenario.jsonl',p/'ordinary.jsonl');print('VALIDATOR_ACCEPTED_WRONG_TARGET',r['snapshots'],r['measurements'])
   except Exception as e: print('VALIDATOR_REJECTED',repr(e))
